title: What Kids Really Need in the Age of AI with Dana Suskind
summary:
What happens when AI starts raising our kids? In this episode of Remarkable People, Dana Suskind joins Guy Kawasaki to explore the future of parenting, human connection, and childhood in the age of artificial intelligence. Dana shares lessons from her new book, Human Raised, explaining why conversation, friction, and imperfect human relationships are essential for healthy brain development. She breaks down where technology can help families flourish—and where it risks replacing what children need most. This conversation will change how you think about parenting, screens, and what it means to be human.
